title: Creating Computer Simulations and Animations in Physics
welcome: Welcome to our interactive physics simulations site.

animation.title: CIRCULAR MOTION:
animation.instructions: Instructions:Addjust radius of the circle,  angular acceleration α, angular velocity ω using sliders and press start button to start animation! Click the step, pause, or reset button to do one iteration, pause loop or restart animation! Tick or untick to change the direction of rotation, show or hide information, show or hide velocity and acceleration vectors!

osp.title: Introduction to OSP (Open Source Physics)
osp.description: OSP is a community-driven project providing free, open‑source physics simulations and tools. Learn about its core components like Tracker, EJS, and the OSP libraries.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our website.

data_collection.title: Data Collection and Processing
data_collection.description: We collect minimal data necessary for the website's functionality, such as IP address and browser information. This data is used solely for traffic analysis and improving user experience.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Our website uses cookies for traffic analysis and enhancing functionality. By using the site, you consent to the use of cookies.

user_rights.title: User Rights
user_rights.description: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. You can also withdraw your consent for data processing at any time.

data_protection.title: Data Protection
data_protection.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: For any questions or requests regarding your personal data, you can contact us via email at: svetprogramiranja23@gmail.com

free_fall.description: Interactive free fall simulation: visualize an object dropping under gravity, adjust initial height and velocity, and explore fundamental motion laws in real-time animation.
free_fall.keywords: free fall simulation, gravity, physics, interactive simulation, initial height, initial velocity, motion laws, educational tool, JavaScript, p5.js

projectile_motion.description: Explore projectile motion through an interactive simulation created with Easy Java Simulations (EJS). Adjust initial velocity, launch angle, and observe the effects of gravity on the trajectory, velocity, and energy of the projectile.
projectile_motion.keywords: projectile motion, physics simulation, parabolic trajectory, Easy Java Simulations, EJS, two-dimensional motion, launch angle, initial velocity, gravity, kinetic energy, potential energy, motion analysis

projectile_motion.description: Explore projectile motion through an interactive simulation created with Easy Java Simulations (EJS). Adjust launch angle and initial velocity, and observe gravity’s effect on trajectory.
projectile_motion.keywords: projectile motion, parabolic trajectory, physics simulation, EJS, launch angle

circular_motion.description: Simulation of uniform circular motion of a material point. Analyze centripetal acceleration, forces, and how speed and radius affect dynamics.
circular_motion.keywords: circular motion, centripetal acceleration, radius, physics simulation

mass_and_spring.description: Interactive mass-and-spring (harmonic oscillator) simulation. Study Hooke’s law, kinetic and potential energy exchanges in real time with EJS.
mass_and_spring.keywords: mass and spring, harmonic oscillator, Hooke’s law, energy exchange, physics simulation

vertical_throw.description: Interactive vertical throw simulation: learn about upward motion under gravity, maximum height, velocity, and displacement in real time.
vertical_throw.keywords: vertical throw, upward motion, maximum height, kinematics, physics simulation
